findings.title: Successful completion bypasses checked generated change timestamp consistency
findings.contract: TIME-D19/D21 require compiler-managed on:create_or_change fields on successful persisted semantic mutation. TIME-D20 excludes database defaults/triggers as a replacement. TIME-D22 keeps provider accepted_at distinct. The user's TIME-D26 shorthand is not the actual timestamp rule: D26 is temporal namespace/API ownership.
findings.cause: Completion acknowledges receipt and executes raw UPDATE todo SET reminder_sent_at without the checked Todo.updated_at generated-change field. The raw path also has no compiler representation-change recording call where such a bound source supports derived representations.
findings.required_correction: In the same owning completion transaction, update checked generated change timestamp(s) only when the guarded still-unsent original-revision source row really changes; retain validated compiler observation/operation-time ownership and provider-time separation. Preserve receipt/sent/timestamp atomic rollback, terminal history, unchanged business schedule revision, and no extra post-admission owner/role/lifecycle cut. Where applicable, use the existing compiler representation-change recording machinery on the returned changed row in this same TX.
findings.implementation_constraint: Blindly calling ordinary touch_Todo_by_id is not sufficient: the emitted touch helper includes deleted_at IS NULL, which would add a forbidden lifecycle cut for an already admitted source subsequently soft-deleted. A narrow private compiler mutation finish path must preserve the accepted completion semantics, not widen ordinary policy or add a new grant.
regression_expectations: Actual accepted HTTP completion changes sent and generated timestamp atomically on both adapters.
Provider accepted_at does not own sent/generated timestamp.
Failed write rolls receipt/state/timestamp back, token survives retry, no second HTTP.
Already-sent/missing/superseded revision and stale fence do not change timestamp or source revision.
Owner disable/soft-delete after cut does not block original same-revision completion.
Relevant derived representation change log remains atomic if that source form is supported.
findings.representation_limit: Current Todo component fixture has no derived representations and generated sink has no recordAuthorityChange/__jadpo_changes symbols. Missing representation log is a source-inspected conditional obligation, not a separately reproduced current-fixture defect.
